# Visual hierachy

## Figure 3A

```{r}
canonical <- c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4")
noncanonical <- c("V2", "V1", "V4", "V3")
hierarchy <- data.table(id = 1:4, canonical, noncanonical)
hierarchy<- melt(hierarchy, id.vars = "id", variable.name = "type", value.name = "value")

plot_hierarchy <-
  ggplot(hierarchy, aes(x = type, y = id, label = value)) +
  geom_label(aes(color = value), size = 5) +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  ggtitle("visual hierarchy") +
  xlab(element_blank()) +
  ylab(element_blank()) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8, family = "Calibri Light"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
plot_hierarchy
```

## Figure 3B/C

```{r}
data <- fread("../data_raw/frequencies_and_bootstrap.csv")
data <- data[frequency > 0, ]

# need to convert the cis to percent
data$lower_ci <- data$lower_ci * 100
data$upper_ci <- data$upper_ci * 100

# ── prep ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
setDT(data)

# max percent across bootstrap, for shared axis
max_percent <- max(data$upper_ci, na.rm = TRUE)
min_percent <- min(data$lower_ci, na.rm = TRUE)

# ── reshape into the df_all format make_gradient_dual expects ────────────────
make_gradient_dual <- function(gradient_id, data, max_percent, min_percent, add_ylab = FALSE) {
  
  dt <- data[gradient == gradient_id & !is.na(order)]
  
  dt[, percent := frequency / sum(frequency) * 100, by = .(group)]
  all_orders <- dt$order
  dt <- tidyr::complete(dt,
    group = c("SC", "CB"), order = all_orders,
    fill  = list(frequency = 0, percent = 0, lower_ci = 0, upper_ci = 0))
  
  setDT(dt)
  
  sc_ordered <- dt[group == "SC"]
  setorder(sc_ordered, percent)
  ordered_levels <- unique(sc_ordered$order)
  dt[, order := factor(order, levels = ordered_levels)]
  dt[, order := droplevels(order)]
  
  assign(paste0("dt_", gradient_id), dt, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  p <- create_lolli_plot3(dt, percent, order,
    paste("Gradient", gsub("G", "", gradient_id)),
    colors    = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"),
    max_break = max_percent,
    min_break = min_percent)
  
  if (add_ylab) p <- p + ylab("Order\n") else p <- p + ylab("")
  p
}

g1_plot <- make_gradient_dual("G1", data, max_percent, min_percent, add_ylab = FALSE)
g2_plot <- make_gradient_dual("G2", data, max_percent, min_percent, add_ylab = FALSE)
g3_plot <- make_gradient_dual("G3", data, max_percent, min_percent, add_ylab = FALSE)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(g3_plot + theme(legend.title = element_blank(), 
                                              legend.position = "bottom",
                                              legend.margin = margin(t = 0.5, unit = "cm")))

chiq_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  g1_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  g2_plot + theme(legend.position = "none") + ylab(""),
  g3_plot + theme(legend.position = "none") + ylab(""),
  ncol = 3
)

figure_3B <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  chiq_row,
  legend,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(4, 0.5)
)
figure_3B

```

# Connectivity gradients within visual areas

```{r}
setwd("../data_tidy/")

dt_long <- readRDS("gradients.RDS")
dt_long <- dt_long[, .(mean_score = mean(gradient_score)),
                   by = .(subject, region, group, gradient, yeo, stream, age, sex, site)]
# dt_long$group <- factor(dt_long$group, levels = c("SC", "CB"))

visual_dt <- dt_long[!is.na(stream),]
visual_dt[, order := rank(mean_score), by = .(subject, stream, group, gradient, age, sex, site)]

visual_sum <- visual_dt[, .(sum_order = length(.I)),
                        by = .(group, stream, order, region, gradient)]

total_orders <- visual_dt[, .(total_order = .N), by = .(group, stream, region, gradient)]
visual_sum <- merge(visual_sum, total_orders, by = c("group", "stream", "region", "gradient"))
visual_sum[, proportion := sum_order / total_order]

all_dist <- readRDS("minimum_distances.RDS")
```

## Figure 3C

```{r}
min_dist_g1_long <- all_dist[gradient == "gradient_1",]
min_dist_g1_long <- min_dist_g1_long[, log_score := log(distance)]

fig_g1 <- create_violin_boxplot(
  data = min_dist_g1_long,
  x_var = "roi",
  y_var = "log_score",
  color_var = "group",
  theme = theme_minimal(),
  y_label = "log(minimum distance)",
  fill_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"),
  color_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71")
)

min_dist_g2_long <- all_dist[gradient == "gradient_2",]
min_dist_g2_long <- min_dist_g2_long[, log_score := log(distance)]

fig_g2 <- create_violin_boxplot(
  data = min_dist_g2_long,
  x_var = "roi",
  y_var = "log_score",
  color_var = "group",
  theme = theme_minimal(),
  y_label = "log(minimum distance)",
  fill_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"),
  color_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71")
)

min_dist_g3_long <- all_dist[gradient == "gradient_3",]
min_dist_g3_long <- min_dist_g3_long[, log_score := log(distance)]

fig_g3 <- create_violin_boxplot(
  data = min_dist_g3_long,
  x_var = "roi",
  y_var = "log_score",
  color_var = "group",
  theme = theme_minimal(),
  y_label = "log(minimum distance)",
  fill_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"),
  color_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71")
)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(fig_g3 + theme(legend.title = element_blank(), 
                                              legend.position = "right"))

figure_3C <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  fig_g1 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  fig_g2 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  fig_g3 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ncol = 3
)
figure_3C

figure_3top <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plot_hierarchy,
  figure_3B,
  labels = "AUTO",
  ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(1, 3.5)
)

figure_3 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  figure_3top,
  NULL,
  figure_3C,
  labels = c("", "","C"),
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(2, 0.1, 1)
)

setwd('../figures')

cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)
ggsave(
  figure_3,
  filename = "figure_4.pdf",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  height = 18,
  width = 18,
  units = "cm",
  bg = "transparent",
  dpi = "print"
)

setwd('../figures')
```

## gradient 1

```{r}
model_g1 <- mixed(as.formula(paste("log(distance) ~ ", fixed_effects, "+ (1|subject)")), data = min_dist_g1_long)
model_g1
```

### EMMs

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
emm_in <- emmeans(model_g1, ~ group | roi, type = "response")

emm_int_df <- summary(emm_in) %>%
  data.table() %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3)
emm_int_df

setwd("../results")
write.csv(emm_int_df, "table_s18.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
post_emm_int <- update(pairs(emm_in), adjust = "holm")
post_df <- data.table(summary(post_emm_int))
post_emm_int <- summary(post_emm_int) %>%
  data.table()  %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3)
post_emm_int

setwd("../results")
write.csv(post_emm_int, "table_s19.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
